### [`figure_heads_unused`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing1.asm#L6) `$DA00-$DB3F`

*data*

<a id="shadow_facing1"></a>
### [`shadow_facing1`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing1.asm#L39) `$DB40-$DBFF`

*data*

Floor shadow blocks for facing 1, pointers $6d-$7b. Each block is the mirror image (table $7e00) of a facing 0 shadow block.
